title: Corrections
description: Correction master data, parsed into Correction (lib/domain/master_data/correction.dart). A correction is a bonus applied to a pool of growth stats and/or abnormality resistances, layered on top of body-color/head-shape resistances as the last step before a DenpaMen is finalized.

id.description: Stable identifier referenced by other data and code.

evasionRateBonus.description: Flat bonus added to evasion rate.

abnormalityResistanceBonuses.description: Flat bonus per abnormality id, added on top of body-color/head-shape resistances.
